page-index-meta-description: Quantaureum is a quantum-safe Layer 1 blockchain: post-quantum cryptography, QPOS consensus and the QVM smart-contract engine. Learn, build and run the network.
page-index-hero-image-alt: An illustration of the Quantaureum network: a lattice of interlinked quantum crystals.
page-index-hero-subtitle: Quantaureum secures every account and every signature with NIST-standard post-quantum cryptography — built from scratch, open source, and running today.
page-index-modal-description: Choose your path: learn about Quantaureum, use the network, or start building.
page-index-features-subtitle: Quantaureum is built from scratch around post-quantum cryptography — not patched on top of legacy schemes.
page-index-features-pq-description-1: Every signature uses Dilithium3 (NIST FIPS 204) and every key exchange uses Kyber768 (NIST FIPS 203). There is no classical fallback left to attack.
page-index-features-pq-description-2: Your account stays secure when large quantum computers arrive.
page-index-features-pq-stat-label: FIPS 203 + FIPS 204 at the protocol core
page-index-features-consensus-descriptio: Proof-of-stake with GM-QTD threshold signatures: blocks finalize only when the validator committee signs — no single key can forge finality.
page-index-features-qvm-description: A purpose-built virtual machine with the QASM contract language and a JIT engine, designed for parallel execution from day one.
page-index-features-scaling-description: Sharding, erasure-coded data availability with FRI commitments, and built-in rollup support.
page-index-features-open-description: Written from zero by an independent developer and released as open source. Everything is public on GitHub.
page-index-arch-subtitle: From post-quantum keys at the bottom to the public API at the top, every layer of Quantaureum is built in-house.
page-index-arch-l6-desc: Node orchestration, mempool and block production
page-index-arch-l5-desc: QPOS staking consensus with QTD threshold-signature finality
page-index-arch-l4-desc: Smart-contract virtual machine, QASM language and JIT compiler
page-index-arch-l3-desc: gossipsub peer networking, staking and incentive economics
page-index-arch-l2-desc: Verkle trie state, encoding and embedded database
page-index-arch-l1-desc: Dilithium3 signatures and Kyber768 key encapsulation (NIST FIPS 204/203)
